headline: NBA: Magic rally in fourth quarter to halt Celtics' six-game winning streak 115-105
teaser: Desmond Bane scores 24 points and Orlando outscores Boston 34-21 in the final frame to pull off a 115-105 upset at TD Garden, while Miami wins its fifth straight.
story:
The Orlando Magic pulled off one of the most impressive road comebacks of the young NBA season on Monday night, 16 November, overcoming a double-digit second-half deficit to beat the Boston Celtics 115-105 at TD Garden.

Sharpshooter Desmond Bane paced the Magic with 24 points and 8 rebounds, connecting on 5 three-pointers to ignite a 34-21 fourth-quarter run that shocked the Boston faithful. Franz Wagner added 22 points and 7 assists, while Orlando's interior defense held Jayson Tatum and Jaylen Brown to just 8-of-25 shooting combined across the final 18 minutes.

The victory snapped Boston's six-game winning streak and improved Orlando to 8-5. Elsewhere on Monday, the Miami Heat won their fifth straight game behind Giannis Antetokounmpo (20 points, 13 rebounds) in a 128-110 rout of Houston, while Joel Embiid dropped a season-high 37 points in Philadelphia's 135-123 triumph over Brooklyn.
whyCareReason: Orlando proves its Eastern Conference contender credentials by halting the defending finalists' six-game winning streak in Boston.
stakes: Orlando (8-5) climbs to fourth in the East while Boston (9-4) drops into second behind Cleveland.
rivalryAngle: Heated Eastern clash at TD Garden where Orlando's perimeter shooting cracked Boston's top-rated perimeter defense.
funFacts: Desmond Bane scored 14 of his 24 points during Orlando's decisive 34-21 fourth-quarter surge.
Orlando held the Celtics to just 39 percent shooting from the field in the second half.
The Magic have won three consecutive regular-season meetings against Boston in Massachusetts.
